hooks.command: if [ -x __CRG_SH__ ]; then __CRG_SH__ hook-update; elif command -v code-review-graph >/dev/null 2>&1; then code-review-graph hook-update; fi; cat >/dev/null || true

cat >/dev/null || true; if [ -x __CRG_SH__ ]; then if git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then __CRG_SH__ status --repo "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || true; else echo 'Not a git repo, skipping'; fi; elif command -v code-review-graph >/dev/null 2>&1; then if git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then code-review-graph status --repo "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || true; else echo 'Not a git repo, skipping'; fi; fi
